content:
### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, excluding Windows Taskbar).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 to 1024, 45):** Contains App Icon/Title on the left; Action Icons and Window Controls on the right.
*   **Sidebar (0, 45 to 280, 940):** Vertical navigation pane. Contains categorized lists of tools.
    *   **Data Recovery Section:** Top section.
    *   **Advanced Features Section:** Middle section.
    *   **File Backup Section:** Bottom section.
*   **Main Content Area (280, 45 to 1024, 940):** White background container.
    *   **Header Region (310, 105 to 680, 155):** Title "Select a location..." with a refresh icon.
    *   **Internal Drives Section (310, 195 to 845, 370):** Label + Horizontal row of 2 device cards.
    *   **Specify Location Section (310, 405 to 750, 700):** Label + Grid of location cards (Recycle Bin, Desktop, Select Folder).
    *   **Footer Region (310, 855 to 980, 900):** Help text link on left, Primary CTA button on right.

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar:**
    *   `Data Recovery` (Section Header)
    *   `Hardware Disk` (Selected Item)
    *   `SD Card`
    *   `More Recovery Tools`
    *   `Advanced Features` (Section Header)
    *   `File Repair`
    *   `Lost Partition Rescue`
    *   `File Backup` (Section Header)
    *   `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Area:**
    *   `Select a location to search for lost data`
    *   `Internal drives (2)`
    *   `Windows(C:)`
    *   `31.16 GB/149.45 GB`
    *   `Temporary Storage(D:)`
    *   `146.12 GB/150 GB`
    *   `Specify a location`
    *   `Recycle Bin`
    *   `Desktop`
    *   `Select Folder`
    *   `Unable to find your hard drive?`
    *   `Search for Lost Data`

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Sidebar Background: `#F5F8FC` (ESTIMATED - Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Main Area Background: `#FFFFFF` (ESTIMATED - White)
    *   Selected Sidebar Item: `#E6F0FF` (ESTIMATED - Light Blue)
    *   Selected Card Border/BG: `#FFFFFF` / Border `#2B85FF` (ESTIMATED)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Headings/Titles): `#1F1F1F` (ESTIMATED - Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text (Labels/Capacity): `#666666` or `#555555` (ESTIMATED - Dark Grey)
    *   Selected Text (Sidebar/Card): `#2B85FF` (ESTIMATED - Bright Blue)
*   **Accents:**
    *   Progress Bar Fill: `#2B85FF` (ESTIMATED)
    *   Progress Bar Track: `#E0E0E0` (ESTIMATED)
    *   CTA Button Background: `#2B85FF` (ESTIMATED - Gradient likely, solid blue base)
    *   Success Checkmark: `#28A745` (ESTIMATED - Green)

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI / System Font, ~9-10px, Regular.
*   **Sidebar Headers:** Segoe UI, ~11px, Regular, Dark Grey.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular (Bold if selected).
*   **Main Heading ("Select a location..."):** Segoe UI, ~20-22px, Semi-bold/Demi-bold.
*   **Section Labels ("Internal drives...", "Specify..."):** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Card Titles ("Windows(C:)", "Desktop"):** Segoe UI, ~14px, Medium weight.
*   **Card Details ("31.16 GB..."):** Segoe UI, ~11-12px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Button Text:** Segoe UI, ~13-14px, Medium/White.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Card Dimensions:** Width ~240px, Height ~110px.
*   **Card Padding:** ~16px internal padding.
*   **Icon Size (Cards/Sidebar):** 32x32px or 48x48px (rendered large).
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Cards: ~6px - 8px.
    *   Button: ~4px - 6px.
    *   Sidebar Selection: ~4px - 6px.
*   **Gutters:**
    *   Between Cards: ~30px horizontal, ~25px vertical.
    *   Sidebar Item Padding: ~10px vertical, ~16px horizontal.
*   **Stroke Widths:**
    *   Selected Card Border: 2px.
    *   Default Card Border: 1px (very light grey or none).

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Window Controls:** Minimize, Maximize (Restore), Close (Top Right). State: Normal.
*   **Sidebar List Items:**
    *   `Hardware Disk`: **State: Selected** (Blue background, Blue text, Green checkmark badge).
    *   `SD Card`, `More Recovery Tools`, etc.: **State: Normal**.
*   **Device Cards:**
    *   `Windows(C:)`: **State: Selected** (Blue border, Blue checkmark circle icon top-right).
    *   `Temporary Storage(D:)`: **State: Normal** (Hover possible, but looks default).
*   **Location Cards (`Recycle Bin`, `Desktop`, `Select Folder`):** **State: Normal**.
*   **Primary Button (`Search for Lost Data`):** **State: Normal/Enabled**. Solid blue background, white text.
*   **Text Link (`Unable to find your hard drive?`):** **State: Normal**. Includes a help icon (circle-question).

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline/Filled hybrid (mostly filled shapes with simple details), Microsoft Fluent Design style.
*   **Grid:** Standard 24x24 or 32x32 grid.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   **Sidebar:** Grid of squares (Hardware), SD Card shape, Wrench/Tools, Folder/File (Repair), Lifebuoy (Rescue), Clock arrow (Backup).
    *   **Main Area:**
        *   **Refresh:** Circular arrow (top right of heading).
        *   **Windows(C:):** Windows Logo grid + Hard Drive cylinder.
        *   **Temporary Storage(D:):** Hard Drive cylinder.
        *   **Recycle Bin:** Bin with recycling arrows.
        *   **Desktop:** Monitor screen.
        *   **Select Folder:** Generic folder icon.
        *   **Selection Indicator:** Circle with checkmark (top-right of selected card).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Selection Ready**. The user is at the first step of the wizard (Select Location). Data is loaded (drives are visible). No loading spinners are active in the main view (the refresh icon is static or just an affordance, though it implies capability).
*   **Motion Cues:** None explicitly captured (static image), but the "refresh" icon suggests a reload action. The green checkmark on the sidebar suggests a completed or recommended step.
